Corner box x 41.1667..62.1667, y -21..0 less the cylinder r=21 centred at (62.1667,-21): the cylinder takes the quarter disc pi 21^2/4 = 346.361 out of the 441 plan area, leaving 94.639 (it meets the back face y=0 at the tip (62.1667,0), tangentially).
